messages.subject: Project Harbor - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Fiona,

Delighted to confirm Project Harbor completed today. The ARA and intercreditor are signed, Tranche A of £5m has drawn and the £5m subordinated loan has been released from the blocked account. Net liquidity uplift on completion is c.£5.9m before the conditional £3m Tranche B.

Funds flow statement attached for your records. Congratulations to the team - a good outcome.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
